heading: Corporate succession and powers and duties acting as trustee; personal liability for malfeasance

tree.heading: Perpetual Succession.—
tree.text: The National Park Foundation shall have perpetual succession.

tree.heading: Powers and Duties of Trustee.—
tree.text: The National Park Foundation shall have all the usual powers and obligations of a corporation acting as a trustee, including the power to sue and to be sued in its own name.

tree.heading: Personal Liability of Board Members.—
tree.text: The members of the Board shall not be personally liable, except for malfeasance.
